notes:
No primary project-table URL supplied. Both DOI-keyed caches contain terminal acquisition misses documenting failed full-text acquisition, not cache-only misses; unavailable routes were not retried. Indexed abstract/section snippets are insufficient for these target tests and were not used for statistics or author success verdicts.
Source follow-up: Blind replication-only validation. Requested target: Regression relationship between simplicity and customer delivery time in the German sample. Rendered primary PDF pp. 7 and 9 were inspected. Tables 6–7 are pooled regressions, not German subgroup regressions. Table 4 explicitly distinguishes present-study measures from Collins et al. (1998) measures: the target outcome and named factor(s) belong to the earlier study. No country-specific coefficient/R-squared or same-test p is printed for this requested combination; all target statistics remain null. Germany appears in Table 1 as a country component of the pooled sample; that count does not establish an analytic N for the requested subgroup test. Source is the published 2006 article copy (available online December 2005), retained as supplied. General support for the model is not a verdict for this absent country-specific test. Unassigned original side was not extracted.
Source follow-up: Published article copy, 1998, pp. 133–146. Rendered PDF pp. 5, 12 and 13 inspected. Fig. 3 shows only rounded country percentages (Germany 32%, Switzerland 12%); its labels are absent from canonical TXT. No exact country-specific analytic n is established; 485 is pooled and has not been substituted. The printed R2 describes the full outcome model with both simplicity and discipline predictors; no separate R2 for only the named predictor family is printed. No omnibus model P-value is printed, so coefficient P-values are not paired with this model R2.
